items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: Charlie Buchanan. He was the manager. ... So that's the main reason why Charlie Buchanan kept me there.

ctx.x: And was that in any way due to Charlie Buchanan, the Savoy? Or was that strictly, as far as -- or simply that Moe Gale just hired you.
No, not Moe Gale. Charlie Buchanan. He was the manager.
